package appliance

import (
    "bytes"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
    "testing"
    "time"

    management "github.com/caelis-labs/memory/api/memory/management/v1alpha1"
    steward "github.com/caelis-labs/memory/api/memory/steward/v1alpha1"
    memory "github.com/caelis-labs/memory/api/memory/v1alpha1"
)

// migrationFixtureBytes gives the fixture a deliberately deterministic random
// stream. It is only used while producing this checked-in test fixture.
var migrationFixtureBytes = bytes.Repeat([]byte{'B'}, 32)

type migrationFixtureReader struct{}

func (migrationFixtureReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
    for i := range p {
        p[i] = migrationFixtureBytes[i%len(migrationFixtureBytes)]
    }
    return len(p), nil
}

func TestGenerateMigrationFixture(t *testing.T) {
    output := os.Getenv("MIGRATION_FIXTURE_OUT")
    if output == "" {
        t.Fatal("MIGRATION_FIXTURE_OUT is required")
    }
    if err := os.MkdirAll(output, 0o700); err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
    now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
    store, err := Open(t.Context(), Options{
        DataDir: output,
        Clock:   func() time.Time { return now },
        Random:  migrationFixtureReader{},
    })
    if err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
    closeStore := func() {
        _, _ = store.db.ExecContext(t.Context(), `PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)`)
        _ = store.Close()
    }
    defer closeStore()

    expires := now.Add(12 * time.Hour)
    bootstrap, err := store.Bootstrap(t.Context(), BootstrapRequest{
        Realms: []Realm{{ID: "realm:migration"}},
        Identities: []Identity{{ID: "identity:migration", RealmID: "realm:migration"}},
        Spaces: []Space{
            {ID: "space:migration", RealmID: "realm:migration", IdentityID: "identity:migration", Class: memory.SpaceClassPrivate},
            {ID: "space:shared", RealmID: "realm:migration", Class: memory.SpaceClassShared},
        },
        Views: []ViewDefinition{
            {ID: "view:migration", RealmID: "realm:migration", ReadSpaceIDs: []memory.SpaceID{"space:migration"}, WriteSpaceID: "space:migration", MaxDisclosureClass: memory.SpaceClassPrivate, RecallPolicyRef: "policy:migration", Version: 1},
            {ID: "view:shared", RealmID: "realm:migration", ReadSpaceIDs: []memory.SpaceID{"space:shared"}, WriteSpaceID: "space:shared", MaxDisclosureClass: memory.SpaceClassShared, RecallPolicyRef: "policy:shared", Version: 1},
        },
        Grants: []Grant{
            {ID: "grant:migration", PrincipalRef: "principal:migration", ActorRef: "actor:migration", ViewRef: "view:migration", AllowedOperations: []memory.Operation{memory.OperationRemember, memory.OperationRecall, memory.OperationReceiptStatus}, AllowedAudiences: []memory.Audience{memory.AudiencePrivate}, ExpiresAt: expires, Version: 1},
            {ID: "grant:shared-reader", PrincipalRef: "principal:reader", ActorRef: "actor:reader", ViewRef: "view:shared", AllowedOperations: []memory.Operation{memory.OperationRecall}, AllowedAudiences: []memory.Audience{memory.AudienceShared}, ExpiresAt: expires, Version: 1},
        },
        IssuerPrincipals: []string{"principal:migration", "principal:reader"},
    })
    if err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }

    profile := steward.ProfileSpec{
        ProfileID: "profile:migration", Version: 1, SystemPrompt: "organize migration evidence",
        MaxContextRecords: 8, MaxInputBytes: 128 << 10, MaxOutputBytes: 16 << 10,
    }
    if _, err := store.PutStewardProfile(t.Context(), management.PutStewardProfileRequest{Profile: profile}); err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
    if _, err := store.BindStewardProfile(t.Context(), management.BindStewardProfileRequest{ProfileID: profile.ProfileID, Version: profile.Version, SpaceIDs: []memory.SpaceID{"space:migration"}}); err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
    const token = "QkJCQkJCQkJCQkJCQkJCQkJCQkJCQkJCQkJCQkJCQkI"
    capability, err := store.IssueCapability(t.Context(), IssueCapabilityRequest{
        Authorization: IssuerAuthorization{PrincipalRef: "principal:migration", Credential: bootstrap.IssuerCredentials["principal:migration"]},
        GrantRef: "grant:migration", ActorRef: "actor:migration", Audience: memory.AudiencePrivate,
        Operations: []memory.Operation{memory.OperationRemember, memory.OperationRecall, memory.OperationReceiptStatus},
        Labels: memory.LabelSet{"workspace:migration"}, TTL: time.Hour,
    })
    if err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
    if string(capability.Token) != token {
        t.Fatalf("deterministic capability token = %q, want %q", capability.Token, token)
    }
    occurred := now.Add(-2 * time.Hour)
    request := memory.RememberRequest{
        Text: "v0.5.2 source receipt survives schema migration",
        SourceContext: memory.SourceContext{
            ActorRef: "actor:migration", SessionRef: "session:v052", WorkspaceRef: "workspace:migration",
            TaskRef: "task:migration-fixture", ToolCallRef: "tool:v052", SourceType: "fixture-source",
            ExtensionLabels: map[string]string{"fixture": "v0.5.2", "origin": "baseline"},
        },
        OccurredAt: &occurred, IdempotencyKey: "fixture-v052-receipt",
    }
    receipt, err := store.Remember(t.Context(), callAuth(capability, "actor:migration", memory.AudiencePrivate), request)
    if err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
    if !receipt.Accepted {
        t.Fatalf("Remember response = %+v", receipt)
    }
    work, found, err := store.ClaimStewardJob(t.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
    if err != nil || !found {
        t.Fatalf("Claim found=%v err=%v", found, err)
    }
    result, err := store.ApplyStewardProposal(t.Context(), work.Lease, steward.Proposal{
        Operation: steward.OperationAdd, Kind: "claim", Text: "The migration source receipt is retained.",
        EvidenceRefs: []memory.ReceiptID{receipt.ReceiptID},
    })
    if err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
    if result.RecordID == "" || result.Revision != 1 {
        t.Fatalf("Apply result = %+v", result)
    }
    if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, "fixture-generated.txt"), []byte("temporary"), 0o600); err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
}
